reservoir_ep17_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_001.text: On One Thousand Two Hundred Twenty-six, Qiu placed the four remaining project dates on the ordinary source board. The chosen role would continue through Twenty-nine, Thirty-four, Thirty-nine and Forty-four, with real pay after performed duties. Its unchosen opportunity had not quietly returned between sessions. The households could still disagree about what they wanted next. Yue had accepted a finite piece of useful work, not authority to decide the whole water timetable or make every person grateful for its result.

reservoir_ep17_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_002.text: The current permitted draws remained Liang's two twelve-litre intervals and Ren's one twenty-four-litre interval. The proposed extra opening had not been ratified or staffed. Their separate project source still held the actual remaining funds appropriate to the accepted plan. Yue checked her ordinary duty range, present recovery and the source she was permitted to receive. Then she prepared to continue that one project while leaving the other real concern visible, rather than borrowing its unavailable records or unpaid labor to complete a more pleasing story.

reservoir_ep17_003.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_003.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-seven, the adult daughter confirmed which limited diary entries could continue through the four remaining dates. Her private employer paper stayed excluded. One optional margin she had withdrawn did not reappear in the next copied form because the receiver thought it useful. Yue checked the pending scope against the actual owner statement before filing it. The project had given her access that required repeated exactness, not a permanent privilege. The daughter seemed less guarded after seeing the earlier withdrawal actually honored, though she still wanted the sleep question answered.

reservoir_ep17_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_004.text: The Ren receiver visited the unchanged physical bay that afternoon and showed the qualified public inspector another scrape on the old cover. Its present condition remained usable within the ordinary method, with the owner instructed to restrict it if the actual flaw worsened. Comparison money had not bought a new fitting. Yue received the public condition account only as context the owner offered, not as a hidden maintenance role. The scrape gave the choice another real consequence. The receiver could cooperate with a diary project while continuing to resent the repair it had left undone.

reservoir_ep17_005.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_005.text: On Twenty-eight, Deng kept Yue's practice modest before the next early field duty. She reported ordinary comfortable condition and the real need to sleep before its morning source. The finite safe sets remained within the old input ceiling and ended with full grounding. She wanted to review the previous diary at night, but its accepted receiving work belonged to the actual duty hours. She put the notes away after the lesson. Protecting sleep was necessary for the candidate as well as the woman whose private sleep account the project hoped to understand.

reservoir_ep17_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_006.text: Two Hundred Twenty-nine was the third actual comparison day. The morning four-hour candidate interval received the current twelve-litre draw and its accepted anonymous observation. Collection and return took twenty-nine minutes; the daughter offered sleep onset at six-fifty-nine, earlier than on the first two dates. No lighter permitted morning quantity had been introduced. Yue recorded the present date and condition rather than attribute the earlier sleep to an unperformed proposal. The household observer's two-hour morning attendance included preparation and source checking, not surveillance inside the private sleeping room.

reservoir_ep17_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_007.text: The evening four-hour interval received current Liang and Ren draw marks and the cleaning observation within its existing scope. The cover still consumed awkward handling, and the wet exit remained. Its actual duration differed slightly from prior dates without a physical repair. Yue completed the eight-hour candidate equivalent and received three actual course coppers. Each household observer had completed four more actual hours, twelve apiece so far; their next three-copper installment would follow the next completed eight-hour equivalent on Thirty-four. No extra wage appeared for an interesting variation in the trace of a household day.

reservoir_ep17_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_008.text: At the limited review, the daughter asked whether earlier sleep on the third date meant the morning work was less important than she thought. Yue said one changed result could not rank its causes without a supported comparison. Current water, ordinary work, household noise and personal rest did not all repeat identically. The woman looked relieved to have her concern retained without a convenient conclusion. Yue found the answer difficult because it offered no quick policy. She could preserve a real unanswered question instead of making the project's selected opportunity look more decisive than its evidence.

reservoir_ep17_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_009.text: On Thirty, Fu and Yue walked the public bank after ordinary rest. Fu wanted to know whether the comparison had made the Ren receiver warmer toward her. Yue said the woman now trusted some corrected wording and still wanted the cover repaired. Fu laughed softly at the recognizable mixture. A relationship could improve in exactness without becoming affectionate. Yue had been tempted to treat cooperation as approval because she wished to be liked. She could continue useful work beside someone who found her choice disappointing, without naming that person unreasonable.

reservoir_ep17_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_010.text: The Ren receiver raised another question at the actual public hour on Thirty-one. The pending aggregate range joined current collection time to later sleep onset in a way that made the interval look continuous. Yue separated the marks and named the unknown gap between them. The receiver accepted the clearer source because her own cleaning account also contained waiting that had not been measured. Her question improved the comparison while the cover remained unchanged. The role had gained an actual skeptical collaborator, which was more demanding than a grateful witness who never interrupted its summary.

reservoir_ep17_011.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_011.text: On Thirty-two, one observer discovered she had used the public preparation clock for a private diary mark whose owner had reported from her own household clock. The two ordinary clocks had not been compared at that date. Yue kept the collection duration and owner-reported sleep onset distinct, withdrawing the unsupported precise gap. The source could preserve an offered household account without pretending every minute was independently synchronized. The daughter approved that honest limitation. Her privacy did not cause the clock difference, and Yue would not blame the withheld employer paper for a comparison it could not have fixed.

reservoir_ep17_012.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_012.text: Tian heard the public clock lesson and said his basket always arrived early because it ignored dates. Yue said that was one reason it received no actual shift. They ate beans with the new clerk, who wanted to know when an approximate mark was still useful. Yue answered from the public distinction: a reported ordinary condition could guide a question if its method remained visible. It could not silently become a calibrated exact interval. The conversation taught the clerk something real while keeping the daughter's private pages outside the lunch table.

reservoir_ep17_013.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_013.text: On Thirty-three, the two observers checked their accepted preparation clocks together before the next field day. The ordinary comparison of clocks could improve future current marks, not repair a past precision they had never established. Yue wrote that boundary into the next source sheet. The project was now collecting better evidence partly because its first imperfect records had been retained honestly. She felt proud of that actual improvement and cautious about turning it into a claim that comparison was therefore the only sensible role. A repaired bay could still have been a valuable different result.

reservoir_ep17_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_014.text: Two Hundred Thirty-four brought the fourth actual comparison duty. The morning twelve-litre collection and return took thirty minutes. The daughter offered sleep onset at seven-nine under her limited account, with its reporting method visible. The current water timetable remained unchanged. Yue's four-hour morning work checked the actual source and accepted scope before preparing the pending aggregate. No employer paper had entered it. The observer completed her actual two-hour window, then left the household to its ordinary private day. A person receiving care or sleep did not become a public exhibit simply because a funded project was interested.

reservoir_ep17_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_015.text: The evening interval observed the current draws and existing cleaning under its accepted public method. The cover remained awkward and the exit still held shallow water. Each household observer completed another four actual hours, sixteen apiece across four dates, and received the second three-copper installment after the actual check. Six more paid observer wages brought their total to twelve from the eighteen allocated. Yue completed her own eight-hour record equivalent and received three course coppers. The separate project fund had spent twenty-two so far, leaving six observer wages and two final dispatch for the last accepted dates.

reservoir_ep17_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_016.text: At the owners' limited review the Liang mother admitted she had imagined the third evening trip as almost free because its volume was small. The current observation had made preparation, waiting and return more visible. Her daughter said she did not want sleep relief purchased through another woman's uncounted fatigue. They began discussing voluntary sharing of the current two draws instead of approving the unstaffed extra opening. Yue listened to the new conversation without claiming the diary had measured that unperformed arrangement. The evidence had changed an actual household question, and the household would decide its own answer.

reservoir_ep17_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_017.text: On Thirty-five the mother offered to collect one future current morning draw herself, while the daughter would take a corresponding current evening draw if both ordinary work calendars allowed it. Each task remained twelve litres under the existing two permitted intervals. They proposed one actual trial day after the project's final review rather than a permanent assignment. The mother would miss a garden conversation that morning, and the daughter would miss a friend's evening meal. Yue recorded the public offered plan only with both owners' consent. Their possible sleep benefit would remain unmeasured until its actual day.

reservoir_ep17_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_018.text: The Ren receiver welcomed the unchanged total and current intervals, because that proposal added no opening inside cleaning. She still asked about physical repair funding. Qiu said the completed comparison source could support a later ordinary request, but no repair fund had been received. The receiver declined to sign any notice implying her concern was closed. Yue retained that refusal beside the pending result. The project's meaningful effect included a specific household alternative and a specific unresolved physical need. It did not require every problem to disappear before the chosen record work could end.

reservoir_ep17_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_019.text: On Thirty-six, Yue left the household question at its actual ordinary desk and attended a modest familiar lesson. Deng asked how she had preserved the unmeasured proposed arrangement in the source. She explained the public offered plan without private details, then grounded before a finite safe input set. The old ceiling remained unchanged. Her current confidence came from correcting particular errors and could still tempt her to overreach. Deng ended the lesson after a sound release. He did not raise her stage because the household discussion had become more interesting.

reservoir_ep17_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_020.text: Jing's father invited her to inspect a bean vine that had fallen across its neighboring support. He wanted to know whether she preferred to untangle it now or leave it until the ordinary garden worker returned. Yue asked what the worker had actually planned. The father admitted he had not asked. Jing laughed and sent him to the actual garden desk. The vine waited harmlessly. Yue found herself enjoying the little refusal to invent somebody else's availability. A useful pattern from the project had reached ordinary life without requiring a lecture about it.

reservoir_ep17_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_021.text: On Thirty-seven, the daughter decided that the final public aggregate could include her owner-reported range of sleep onset with its method visible. It could not include private employer timing, wage amount or the withdrawn margin. Yue checked the release against the actual permitted pages. The owner had offered more public detail now than at the start, but this new consent did not retroactively make the excluded paper accessible. The comparison role had developed through real choices by its participants. Their trust still needed a receiver who remembered exactly where it ended.

reservoir_ep17_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_022.text: Thirty-eight was a preparation day, not an extra paid eight-hour candidate duty. Yue used the ordinary public hour to confirm the next accepted record source, then returned to rest before the early morning. The observer schedules remained finite and actually accepted. No worker had been summoned to fill a conveniently blank interval. The Ren receiver declined a suggested unpaid extra observation outside her agreed windows. The project kept its six dates. More evidence might have been useful, but its actual price in somebody's time remained visible enough to stop the request.

reservoir_ep17_023.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_023.text: Two Hundred Thirty-nine began the fifth actual comparison duty. The current twelve-litre morning collection and return took twenty-eight minutes. The daughter offered sleep onset at seven-five under the visible household reporting method. No lighter draw or voluntary sharing trial had yet occurred. Yue received the actual limited entry during the morning four-hour interval and prepared its supported date. The observers' clock checks were kept with their own current observation, while the owner's private account retained its actual method. Better preparation did not authorize a false claim that every field mark had become identical.

reservoir_ep17_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_024.text: The evening four-hour interval received the current draws and Ren's accepted cleaning account. The physical cover and wet exit remained unchanged. Yue completed the actual eight-hour equivalent and received three course coppers. Each household observer had now completed twenty hours across the five dates, with four more needed before the final three-copper installment. The pending aggregate showed current durations ranging across days, not a demonstrated sleep effect from the unperformed lighter-water proposal. Yue read its limitations aloud at the limited owners' review. The daughter said she preferred that answer to a confident invented benefit.

reservoir_ep17_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_025.text: On Forty, the Ren receiver asked whether the public result should include the unchanged cover explicitly. Yue agreed and added the actual physical condition in the accepted public scope. Comparison had not made the repair less urgent simply because it had clarified a household plan. The receiver offered no warm thanks, but accepted that her concern would survive the project's ending. Yue had chosen an opportunity that improved the questions she could ask and left something tangible untouched. She could live beside that consequence without changing the record into an apology that promised unfunded work.

reservoir_ep17_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_026.text: At supper Fu said her brother wanted to perform the song at the final project meal. Yue asked whether the actual owners wanted a meal or only their record review. Fu admitted she had not asked. They did ask, and both receivers preferred a short quiet review followed by ordinary food separately if anybody wished. The song would stay at the garden. Yue liked watching the request become smaller and more accurate. A project involving tired people did not need a festive occasion arranged to make its ending look happier than its participants wanted.

reservoir_ep17_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_027.text: On Forty-one, the two household observers reviewed their actual received wages and final attendance terms. Six coppers each had been paid after sixteen completed hours; the last four-hour day would bring each to twenty-four and release the final three. Their accepted ordinary work source remained eighteen in total, with no unperformed hours counted. Yue checked the project receiver's statement within her current role. The observers' finite employment would close after the actual result handover, not follow her into a later basin post as unpaid familiarity.

reservoir_ep17_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_028.text: Forty-two brought another ordinary lesson at modest demand. Yue felt recovered for the familiar safe set and reported no headache or new shoulder pain. Deng changed an ordinary spoken question after she released, asking her to describe the room before the water source. She answered the actual question this time. He recorded useful attention in teaching and ended on time. The later qualifying series remained an independent test under changed conditions. An ordinary lesson could reveal improvement without lending it a certificate whose required mornings had not yet happened.

reservoir_ep17_029.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_029.text: On Forty-three the daughter and mother agreed to try the current-draw sharing on Fifty-one if both actual calendars remained suitable then. The mother would take the twelve-litre morning draw, the daughter the twelve-litre evening one, with current volumes and intervals unchanged. Each acknowledged the ordinary conversation or meal she would miss. The plan required no extra valve opening and no new staff. Yue wrote the owners' public offered agreement with its actual review date. It was a meaningful different household action emerging from their comparison, without pretending the diary had already measured its future sleep effect.

reservoir_ep17_030.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_030.text: Two Hundred Forty-four completed the sixth actual comparison day. The morning current collection and return took twenty-seven minutes, with owner-reported sleep onset at seven-one under the visible method. The evening source confirmed the unchanged two and one draws and actual cleaning condition. Yue completed both four-hour duty intervals, checked the final supported aggregate and received three course coppers for the actual eight-hour equivalent. The two observers completed their final four hours apiece and each received the last three-copper installment, eighteen actual observation wages paid across their six dates.

reservoir_ep17_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_031.text: The owners approved the public aggregate within its named scope. Current morning collection durations ranged from twenty-seven to thirty minutes across six observed dates; owner-reported sleep onset varied within the offered range, with methods visible and causes left unproved. The physical cover and exit remained unchanged. No lighter morning or extra evening interval had been tested. The daughter's original limited diary returned to its owner after the accepted handover, with no private employer paper received. Yue retained only the public approved aggregate and her permitted own questions.

reservoir_ep17_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_032.text: On Two Hundred Forty-five, the actual final two-copper dispatch delivered the approved result to its accepted household destinations. All thirty project coppers had now been spent as ratified: eighteen actual observation wages, eight received materials and four actual dispatch. The six candidate record duties had separately paid eighteen from the existing course line. The current water timetable remained, with one future voluntary sharing trial offered by its owners. The Ren receiver's repair concern remained unresolved. Yue closed the finite comparison role without claiming a complete cure for the quarrel or retaining private pages she had been allowed only to receive.

reservoir_ep17_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_033.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-seven, the qualified worker confirmed the four remaining ordinary stages: install the accepted low fitting, finish the second channel section, test its current operating condition, and complete the owners' final inspection. His tools remained his and the shared installation would belong to its actual owners. Yue's source role stayed at the low table. The daughter had offered no sleep diary under maintenance. The current project could change physical work while leaving a household question unknown, which Yue would need to remember whenever the new metal looked persuasive.

reservoir_ep17_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_034.text: The Ren receiver used the accepted temporary bay condition and said she was glad the first channel section no longer held the same shallow pool. She still wanted the permanent fitting complete. Yue received that public operating account with its place and date, not as a general measured reduction in cleaning time. The receiver had become warmer toward her, but warmth could also tempt her to write more than the source supported. The next actual notices would need the same care as the first correction about unmeasured sleep.

reservoir_ep17_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_035.text: On Twenty-eight the ordinary supplier delivered the final accepted fastenings within the already paid material order. The qualified worker checked their dimensions before installation, and Yue received the actual condition mark. The earlier wrong-length piece had been exchanged rather than installed and repaired through luck. No extra project fund appeared. Eight materials, four delivery and the reserved eighteen wages still described its whole separate thirty. Ordinary competence could make a careful estimate work without a cultivator providing an impossible tool or a benefactor rescuing an uncounted cost.

reservoir_ep17_036.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_036.text: Two Hundred Twenty-nine began the third actual physical day and Yue's third record duty. The qualified worker installed the accepted low fitting under the dry work condition, keeping its heavier handling inside his ordinary method. Yue compared the actual stages at the low source table and left the tools in his hands. The current permitted draws used the checked temporary route until the installation's first condition inspection was complete. The owners had agreed to that specific work window. Their water did not vanish because the project needed a convenient empty site.

reservoir_ep17_037.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_037.text: The afternoon installation check found one fastening too tight against the ordinary movement clearance. The worker loosened and reset it before accepting the fitted condition. Yue recorded the actual correction and its repeated check, rather than mark the first attempt sound because the final object looked useful. At the end of the accepted eight-hour day, he received three project wage coppers and she received three course coppers for her own completed record equivalent. The project had spent twenty-one so far, leaving nine for three actual qualified days still ahead.

reservoir_ep17_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_038.text: The Ren receiver tested the permitted ordinary opening after the worker's condition check. The lower fitting reduced one awkward reach and closed properly. She wanted to call the whole cleaning problem solved, and Yue asked whether the unfinished channel section had also changed. It had not. The receiver corrected her own public account to the fitted motion she had actually used. Their warmer relationship survived the exact question. Yue had gained a physical result worth welcoming without needing to let affection enlarge its scope into a complete answer.

reservoir_ep17_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_039.text: On Thirty, Deng kept practice modest after the actual record day. Yue reported ordinary fatigue, no headache and no new shoulder pain. They practiced the familiar full release before discussing the new fitting. The old eighth-unit breath ceiling remained unchanged, as did the half-unit familiar four-breath input total. A well-built ordinary installation had required no greater qi throughput. Yue noticed how reassuring tangible work could make her feel about the harder reservoir. Deng accepted the confidence as a feeling and retained independent measurement for its actual current quantity.

reservoir_ep17_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_040.text: Fu asked whether the new cover had made the daughter less disappointed. Yue said the woman had acknowledged its visible benefit and still wanted her morning sleep question answered. Fu liked the distinction because she disliked being told to be pleased about a different problem. They sat beneath the bean supports and discussed ordinary supper. Yue had not acquired the private diary through a warmer receiver or a useful installed object. The maintenance choice continued to close something she wanted, making its physical opportunity real rather than a path that quietly granted every source.

reservoir_ep17_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_041.text: On Thirty-one the daughter visited the public bay and tried the current ordinary low fitting herself under the owner's accepted condition. She said it was easier to handle than the old cover. Yue recorded that public physical statement only when the woman consented. Then the daughter asked whether her limited diary could still be requested under a new future project. Qiu said a new purpose, receiver and fund would be needed if paid observation was proposed. Her original private pages remained unavailable now. The maintenance role had not erased her ability to offer them differently later.

reservoir_ep17_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_042.text: The Liang mother admitted she had expected the physical repair to make the proposed third interval automatically acceptable. The valve keeper restated the additional opening's actual staff need and the cleaning window it would overlap at eighteen-forty-five. A lower cover did not pay for his extra duty or shift another owner's time. The mother withdrew the immediate extra-opening request rather than treat the completed fitting as permission. Her current two twelve-litre draws remained. Yue saw a real limit survive beside a real improvement, with nobody claiming the disappointment had been cured by metal.

reservoir_ep17_043.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_043.text: On Thirty-two, the worker inspected the second channel section's actual obstruction before the next funded day. The owners allowed its ordinary public physical scope; private household routines were not part of it. One debris pocket lay beyond the planned section and would require a separate future owner task if it worsened. The present accepted work could finish its specified channel without pretending to clear every path in the basin. Yue received the exact boundary and put it on the pending notice. A finite useful repair did not need an unlimited contract to remain worthwhile.

reservoir_ep17_044.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_044.text: Tian asked whether the basket might be hired to carry debris. The worker said an ordinary sound carrier could be useful under its owner's agreement, but this job already had accepted equipment. Tian claimed the basket had only been conducting market research. Yue laughed and let the joke end without creating a new unpaid helper role. The selected maintenance work had actual ordinary labor and tools from its named source. Friendship could visit the site without becoming free capacity added to make a difficult estimate appear effortlessly generous.

reservoir_ep17_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_045.text: On Thirty-three Yue prepared the next low-table source checks and kept the evening free for actual rest. The maintenance project's second channel stage would occupy tomorrow's accepted work. Deng's modest lesson ended before fatigue, and no extra intake was performed at night to chase a reserve quantity. The physical site had improved one motion. Her reservoir's changed conditions remained unpassed. She could hold both truths without turning the bay into a metaphor that supplied missing physiological evidence. Ordinary sleep was the practical preparation for a real paid day.

reservoir_ep17_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_046.text: Two Hundred Thirty-four began the fourth actual qualified maintenance day. The worker cleared and fitted the accepted second channel section under its ordinary dry condition. Yue received the baseline, removed-debris and completed-section notices, checking each against its actual owner and date. The heavier material handling stayed with the qualified worker. During the current permitted draw the checked route remained available, so the project's work did not require an unauthorized household delay. The actual cleaning interval would later use a wider low exit within its current accepted time.

reservoir_ep17_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_047.text: The worker completed the eight-hour day and received three coppers from the separate project wage line. Yue completed her eight-hour record equivalent and received three course coppers. The project had spent twenty-four in all: eight materials, four delivery and twelve paid qualified work. Six remained for the final two actual physical days. The widened second section still required current operating checks and owners' final acceptance. No private sleep measurement had been received, and the notice would not announce a household effect the selected role had never been offered access to compare.

reservoir_ep17_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_048.text: At that evening's current cleaning, the Ren receiver used the accepted second-section condition and said the exit felt less awkward. Yue retained the public statement and actual place without inventing a calibrated duration. The daughter watched from the sound path and looked pleased at the drier footing. She did not offer a private diary as a reward. Yue appreciated the visible pleasure while leaving its boundary intact. A useful physical change could earn a warmer ordinary conversation and still leave another source unavailable, which mattered to how she would later describe the project.

reservoir_ep17_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_049.text: On Thirty-five the households reviewed their current water request. The Liang daughter said she would not claim the fitting had measured a sleep gain, and the Ren receiver said it had changed her ordinary cleaning movement. They withdrew the immediate extra evening opening from the pending list. Future changes would need their own supported staffing and consent. Current two and one draws remained, with equal twenty-four-litre totals and different real intervals. The maintenance project had helped their shared physical work without making the old quarrel or private sleep question disappear.

reservoir_ep17_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_050.text: Fu asked Yue whether she wanted to celebrate the owners agreeing on that withdrawal. Yue welcomed the agreement and said the daughter still wanted a lighter morning. Fu understood; a request could be withdrawn for lack of a safe funded plan without its need vanishing. They ate ordinary beans and discussed the next garden song. Yue did not request private testimony to improve the final maintenance notice. The selected work was already interesting enough: physical stages, actual sources, warmer and cooler relationships, and a particular human concern it could not answer.

reservoir_ep17_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_051.text: On Thirty-six, the qualified worker tested the fitted cover's ordinary motion without a household draw underway. The accepted installed condition remained sound, and he named what the later current-flow check would still examine. Yue received the statement during the actual public preparation hour, not as another paid eight-hour candidate day. The duty schedule remained six finite dates. More visits did not create more wages. The worker also made clear that his tools would leave after the final acceptance; nobody should list them as cooperative property because they had been used beside a shared fitting.

reservoir_ep17_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_052.text: Thirty-seven brought a small argument at the bay when a visitor tried to use the new lower cover as a seat. The ordinary attendant explained that its fitting had been accepted for its actual operation, not a new load. The visitor moved to the bench. Yue appreciated the plain task distinction and resisted quoting her own shoulder limits as a lesson for everyone. The physical installation would also need separate clearance for an unfamiliar demand. A useful improvement could remain sound when its users understood what had actually been checked.

reservoir_ep17_053.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_053.text: On Thirty-eight Yue prepared the current operating record for the fifth funded maintenance day. She asked the Ren receiver which actual condition she wanted inspected, and the woman named the flow after her permitted twenty-four-litre draw. The daughter offered no new private sleep account. The separate roles remained intact. Deng's modest practice afterward used the familiar safe input and full release, with no larger draw attached to the approaching inspection. Yue went to bed early, leaving the site's pending page with its ordinary custodian rather than carry it into the room as a reason not to sleep.

reservoir_ep17_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_054.text: Two Hundred Thirty-nine was the fifth actual physical and record day. The qualified worker observed the accepted current draw and inspected both channel sections under the stated ordinary flow condition. Water passed the fitted exit without the earlier shallow pool at the checked location. A small residue remained beyond the accepted section and was marked for the owners' separate future attention. Yue received the exact current notice at the low table. The installation had achieved its finite purpose without pretending one paid worker had repaired every neighboring obstruction.

reservoir_ep17_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_055.text: The worker completed the eight-hour day and received three project coppers; Yue completed her eight-hour record equivalent and received three course coppers. The separate project had spent twenty-seven, leaving three for the final actual day and owner acceptance on Forty-four. The Ren receiver looked pleased and asked for a public notice describing the checked flow. Yue prepared it within the approved physical scope. She did not include sleep, private employer timing or the unapproved extra opening. The notice could be useful because it said what changed, with the remaining boundary still visible.

reservoir_ep17_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_056.text: On Forty the daughter read the pending notice and said she appreciated its refusal to pretend she had become rested. Her morning collection still used twelve litres under the current six-o'clock mark. She might propose another household arrangement after discussing the actual calendars, but had not offered that record here. Yue let the unanswered concern remain. The Ren receiver's gratitude was genuine and particular. The daughter's guarded trust was also real. The maintenance path had not reduced relationships to a single reward for whichever useful object Yue helped receive.

reservoir_ep17_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep17_057.text: Forty-one and Forty-two passed with ordinary modest practice and the final physical preparation. The worker checked the remaining accepted fastening, and the owners chose where the public operating copy would stay after his tools left. Yue retained no ownership claim to the fitting, materials or site merely because she had received their notices. She could carry permitted own observations about accurate physical scope.
